name: io.github.AudialAI/audial-mcp
description: Audial audio tools: stems, analysis, mastering, sample packs, MIDI, music generation, vocals.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIAL_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Audial user id. Only needed with an older API key that does not start with aud_.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIAL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Audial API key, for servers and CI. Leave unset to sign in through the browser on first use.

environmentVariables.name: AUDIAL_JOB_TIMEOUT_S
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a job before giving up

environmentVariables.name: AUDIAL_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Audial API base URL (advanced)
